candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR operations between bits. Using AND instead of XOR for bit 2 will produce incorrect binary values, leading to wrong Gray code outputs after conversion back.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires Gray code to binary conversion using XOR operations between bits (step 2 of the process)

candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion requires XOR operations between bits. Using OR instead of XOR for bit 1 will produce incorrect binary values, affecting the final Gray code output.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires Gray code to binary conversion using XOR operations between bits (step 2 of the process)

candidates.violated_requirement: Binary-to-Gray conversion should use XOR between the binary value and its right-shifted version. Using AND instead will produce incorrect Gray code sequences that don't follow the single-bit change property.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires binary to Gray code conversion using XOR (step 4 of the process)
